name.en: Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon, the Guided Phantom Beast
name.ja: 導かれし幻獣－<ruby>青眼の亜白龍<rt>ブルーアイズ・オルタナティブ・ホワイト・ドラゴン</rt></ruby>

text.en: If this card is in your hand: You can banish 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck; Special Summon this card, then you can place 1 "Endless Darkness" from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Field Zone. If you have a banished "Blue-Eyes" monster: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it, also this card cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon, the Guided Phantom Beast" once per turn.
